title: Threshold sign from a nearby sign value
statement: Let $y,r\in\mathbb R$ with $y=1$ or $y=-1$ and $|y-r|<1$. For $sigma(t)=1$ when $t\ge0$ and $sigma(t)=-1$ when $t<0$, one has $sigma(r)=y$.
replaced:
Let $y,r\in\mathbb R$ with $y\in\{-1,1\}$ and $|y-r|<1$.
For $\sigma(t)=1$ when $t\ge0$ and $\sigma(t)=-1$ when $t<0$, one has $\sigma(r)=y$.
